stations.instrument: Apostolic constitution Si quid est in rebus humanis
stations.title: Urban VIII issues the further emended Missal

cited.basis: The canticle changes with the hour: Magnificat in the pre-1955 witnesses (missale-romanum-1920 41449-41460), Benedictus in the 1962 witness (benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 43466-43482).
The witness prints `T VALDE ma-ne` at benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 43482, the Benedictus antiphon of Easter morning, where the pre-1955 books print `Vespere autem sabbati`.

stations.title: Maxima redemptionis restores the order of Holy Week
